comparison: Predict class 1 when the float64 weighted mean of the archived class-1 probabilities is greater than or equal to 0.40.
reason: This blend attained the highest full-dev macro-F1 in the declared 21-candidate search. Its family also had the highest repeated-fold mean, with two source models. The decision used dev labels only.
validation_caveat: Repeated folds evaluate weight and threshold fitting after checkpoint selection. The source checkpoints already used the full dev set. Family-specific fold scores also precede choosing the final family, so the overall candidate-selector result is reported separately.
